tos.title: Tears of Steel
tos.credits_note: Frame sampling 2026-09-06: film through 587s, credits card at 588s. The credits run to ~710s and are followed by a POST-CREDITS SCENE, ~711-734s, which is film. It is excluded anyway: three bins separated from the body by 123s of credits have no valid local baseline. The upload's maximum attention sits at bin 97, which is that scene - people jump to the stinger, and on a most-replayed heatmap that is what it looks like. Treating it as film-with-high-attention is what produced position_bias 4.40.

bbb.title: Big Buck Bunny (2008 original)
bbb.note: NOT the 2013 Sunflower re-release, which runs ~40s longer. The YouTube upload the heatmap comes from is 597s, matching the original at 596.5s. Using Sunflower would shift every timecode and fail silently.
bbb.credits_note: Frame sampling 2026-09-05: last film frame 488s, first credit card by 491s. No post-credits scene.

sintel.title: Sintel
sintel.note: Blender hosts only a 1.1GB 1080p mkv for this one, and that download died twice at ~500MB. The archive.org mirror of the Blender release is 270MB and arrived in a minute. Its 74MB sibling is NOT usable despite being named 2048: it decodes at 564x240, and cutting 360p clips from it would mean upscaling Sintel while tos and bbb are downscaled from 1280 and 853 - a picture-quality difference between films, in the one comparison the third film exists to make. Duration 888.064s matches the heatmap's 888s.
sintel.credits_note: Frame sampling 2026-09-06: film through 743s, black at 745s, first credit card at 747s. No bin midpoint falls between 744 and 748, so the earlier 748 estimate selected the same segments.
